author: Andrew Fisher

checks: Acceptance is pending; dialog stays open and never claims delivered
Explicit refresh confirms delivered by message ID, without resending
A failed delivery report is visibly failed
Mixed accepted and rejected recipients keep separate results
SUCCESS is exact: UNSUCCESSFUL never counts as acceptance
Unknown provider status does not unlock a potentially duplicate send
Timeout is unknown and duplicate send remains blocked after editing
Accepted send cannot be duplicated through edits or Full details
Unsupported status endpoint preserves acceptance and says delivery is unavailable
Delivery lookup timeout does not mark accepted text as failed or resend
Dry-run remains explicitly unsent and allows a later actual send
Dry-run after acceptance does not erase the earlier delivery state
Rapid double click makes one submission while response is pending
Prepare another message requires confirmation for unresolved result
Out-of-order delivery reports reconcile by ID, not recipient order
Missing or foreign report rows cannot confirm an unrelated delivery
HTTP failure with provider UNKNOWN never asserts nothing was sent
Recipient numbers with spaces remain one number per comma/semicolon
No recipient makes no messaging request
Unconfigured messaging keeps manual copy/open fallback
Picture-message acceptance does not imply delivery; unsupported tracking stays explicit
Unticking the picture sends text only through the SMS endpoint
Picture generation failure leaves a visible explanation and disables the picture option
Result and controls stay within the viewport
